evidence.detail: R16 ConfigManager is the only exact-v308 application owner of rs/e/c; its reviewed evidence already identifies a ConfigStore backing the configuration lifecycle.
The constructor accepts one File, loads UTF-8 java.util.Properties when present, and copies every key/value into a ConcurrentHashMap used for live configuration reads.
Synchronized put/remove/bulk-update operations modify the live map while separately recording changed keys in a dirty Map; c() atomically swaps out and returns that pending delta map.

The persistence path merges dirty changes with on-disk properties, writes UTF-8 properties through a locked temporary file, flushes and FileChannel.force(true), then replaces the target with ATOMIC_MOVE plus a REPLACE_EXISTING fallback when atomic move is unsupported.
The class contains no proxy/descriptor/UI behavior; it is the persistence storage layer beneath ConfigManager and the R16 configuration framework.

candidates.note: ConfigStore closes the class identity already structurally referenced by R16 ConfigManager evidence; exact v308 proves the file-backed live-map/delta persistence role.
